title: Ancient Fields: Further Work on Inyanga Terracing (Zimbabwe) and Engaruka Irrigation (Tanzania)
lineage: Scanned issue containing Sutton’s primary report on measurements and observations from the 1982 survey.

passages.quote: further work on the abandoned irrigation system at the foot of the rift escarpment at Engaruka

passages.note: Sutton reports stone-sided channels and sub-furrows serving groups of stone-divided cultivation plots. His survey does not identify the excavated Section 11 sequence.
